title: PR body omits the [E10] citation that AC3 explicitly enumerates
evidence: grep -n "E10" _bmad-output/pr-bodies/5.11.md → zero hits; grep for the other AC3 citations hits: line 3 "catalogs `[ODN-5]`, director `[ODN-7]`", line 11 "(E9.1 even without the sheet)", line 10 "every spawn E31-valid + 5.6-separated". The only replay mention is line 49: "- `tools/ci-local.sh --mac`: **10/10 gates green** (lint, 193 core tests, app build, golden harness ×33 demos + replay gate, palcheck, W1 drift-rejection 233/233 mutations, preview cross-check, PP_DEBUG builds, stats replay-identity, input parity 24/24)." The [E10] tag appears only in demos/terminal_types.dem: "(replay byte-identical\n# [E10])".
detail: Briefing AC3 requires the PR body to carry "citations `[ODN-5]` `[ODN-7]` `[E10]` `[E31]` `[E9.1]`". Four are present; [E10] (replay byte-identical) is never cited in the PR body, only implied as "replay gate".
recommended_fix: Add the literal `[E10]` tag to the PR body's replay claim (e.g. "golden harness ×33 demos + replay gate — replay byte-identical `[E10]`").
